verdict.rationale: Privacy posture, including what data is kept and how it is deleted, is a fair question for any software tool, including a locally run open-source game engine. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of data retention or deletion controls, telemetry settings, or a privacy policy. The mention of imported resources kept in res://.godot/imported/ describes the asset pipeline, not a retention control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
